To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

by using asymmetric stack, comprising of electrodes with different work function values, the non-volatality can be induced within state-of-the art DRAM capacitor stacks, which results in excellent endurance.
by using an asymmetric capacitor stack comprising electrodes with different electrode workfunction values, the non-volatililty can be induced in AFE ZrO2.
by using a stack with different work function electrodes, an internal bias field in ZrO2 is created which makes the material non-volatile.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the investigation of a novel non-volatile memory based on the anti-ferroelectrics ZrO2 and HfO2.
the development of novel materials, structures and concepts for future memories.
the investigation of the possibility to make the state-of-the art ZrO2 DRAM capacitor non-volatile.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the non-volatality of the ZrO2 based memory can be achieved by utilizing an internal bias field.
the AFE ZrO2 NV memory is the first NV memory based on a dielectric which can be integrated in the state-of-the art DRAM stack, without requiring additional processing steps.
the AFE NV memory has a great potential to replace the state-of-the art ferroelectric memory, due to its excellent endurance.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have demonstrated how the non-volatile memory can be introduced within state-of-the art DRAM capacitor stacks, and that it can be achieved by utilizing the asymmetry in the stack.
the non-volatilty of the ZrO2 based DRAM capacitors can be induced without any modifications to the existing fabrication processes.
by utilizing a simple stack design and by applying a single control gate voltage pulse, a non-volatility is introduced to the state-of-the art AFE DRAM capacitor stacks.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the non-volatilty can be introduced to the state-of-the-are DRAM capacitor stack, which can be used for the realization of a novel AFE NV DRAM memory.
the AFE NV memory can be used as a non-volatile memory element in DRAM, enabling further scaling.
by using a simple and well-established technology, the endurance of FE memories can be significantly increased.
